pages.subtitle: SCHEME OF WORK · GRADE 1
pages.html:
Grade 1 · Scheme of Work
How to Use This Scheme
This guide follows the order of lessons in the Crystal Phonics Grade 1 book. Adjust pace for your class, but keep the sequence of patterns.
#Guidance
1Warm-up — review previous sound / tile for 3–5 minutes.
2Teach — introduce the week’s pattern from the lesson page (tile + intro text).
3Word grid — say and read each word; clap syllables if needed.
4Decodable — read sentences aloud; circle target words.
5Fill-in blanks — independent or guided spelling practice.
6Sight words — 5–10 high-frequency words daily (not only phonics patterns).
7Review weeks (12, 24, 36) — oral reading check + short spelling dictation of the term’s patterns.
8Sight words by term — Term 1: 33 words · Term 2: 33 words · Term 3: 32 words (full list of 98 divided evenly). See each term page for the exact words.
